'''Nyine''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith Inquisitor]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Stationed on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], she owned a small shop where she bought, sold, and created artifacts and relics.
